title: Verify feature-gated watch recipes
changes: Document an audit-enabled RAM read watch in a typed recipe and the corresponding default-build feature refusal.
Clarify that typed recipes do not dispatch campaign run-case and do not enforce reopening reasons for manually repeated evidence.
validation: An isolated audit-enabled session recorded one RAM read hit during an HLE/DMA-inclusive interpreter step, passed a hit assertion and completed its next step; an explicit second resume preserved checkpoint and guest state.
The default build recorded feature refusal with the next step still planned and guest state unchanged; both windows closed normally and protected inputs were unchanged.
limitations: This covers one read hit and one refusal in Linux/Xvfb with silent audio, not guest-instruction attribution, Wine or native Windows feature-enabled watch behavior.
Recipe-level enforcement of a reopening reason for equivalent concluded evidence remains unresolved; the existing campaign run-case enforces it separately.
